name: sample-noisy-request-logs
description: Keep 10% of warning-free py3-api 304s and py3-tasks-io task queue 200s
filter: log_id("appengine.googleapis.com/request_log") AND ((resource.labels.module_id="py3-api" AND protoPayload.status=304) OR (resource.labels.module_id="py3-tasks-io" AND protoPayload.status=200 AND protoPayload.resource:"/_ah/queue")) AND severity<WARNING AND sample(insertId, 0.9)
